newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 28.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
China publishes a collection of works on promoting socialist ethical and cultural progress, including speeches by paramount leader Deng Xiaoping and Communist Party chief Jiang Zemin.
An international trade official says stronger trade ties between the mainland and Taiwan are inevitable despite current obstacles between the two sides.
China's seeded area rises by 1.3 percent, or 1.92 million hectares, to 152 million hectares this year compared with last year.
National People's Congress chairman Qiao Shi says China's economic and social development requires a plan of sustainable development, and that such a plan will benefit the world as well.
